# Master Frontend Design & Motion Engineering

This skill dictates high-fidelity visual identity, token architecture, and motion constraints for all frontend code generated by Antigravity. It unifies senior design taste, anti-AI boilerplate heuristics, Material Design 3 (M3) UX fluidity, and 3D spatial motion physics.

---

## 1. Active Baseline Configuration
* **DESIGN_VARIANCE: 8** (1 = Strict Symmetry, 10 = High Asymmetry / Editorial Layout)
* **MOTION_INTENSITY: 6** (1 = Static Transitions, 10 = Cinematic Spring Physics)
* **VISUAL_DENSITY: 4** (1 = Airy Art Gallery, 10 = Packed Cockpit Dashboard)

> **Directive:** The default baseline for all generations is (8, 6, 4). Adapt these dynamically when explicitly requested.

---

## 2. Token Systems & Material Architecture

### A. Dark-Mode Canvas & Elevation Layers
* **Base Background**: Deep slate/zinc undertones (`#030712`, `#070b14`, `#090d16`) rather than harsh pure `#000000`.
* **Surface Elevations**:
  - `Surface 0 (Canvas)`: `#070b14`
  - `Surface 1 (Cards / Panels)`: `rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.7)` with `backdrop-filter: blur(16px)`
  - `Surface 2 (Elevated Modals / Drawers)`: `rgba(30, 41, 59, 0.8)` with `backdrop-filter: blur(20px)`
  - `Surface 3 (Overlays / Menus)`: `rgba(51, 65, 85, 0.85)`
* **Refractive Glass Specularity**:
  ```css
  backdrop-filter: blur(16px) saturate(180%);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
  box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1), 0 20px 40px -15px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
  ```

### B. Color Calibration & The AI-Purple Ban
* **The Lila / Neon Purple Ban [CRITICAL]**: The generic "AI Purple/Blue" gradient aesthetic is strictly BANNED. Ground palettes in slate/zinc bases with deliberate, high-contrast brand accents (Emerald `#10b981`, Warm Amber `#f59e0b`, Electric Cobalt `#2563eb`, Crimson `#f43f5e`).
* **Maximum Accent Saturation**: < 80%. Never exceed 1 dominant accent hue per interface.
* **Palette Temperature**: Maintain single temperature (cool slate or warm neutral) across all component trees.

---

## 3. Typography & Structural Layout

### A. Expressive Font Pairing
* **Display / Headlines**: `Geist`, `Cabinet Grotesk`, `Plus Jakarta Sans`, or `Satoshi`. Avoid defaulting to plain `Inter` for flagship interfaces.
  - Tracking: `tracking-tighter` (`-0.025em` to `-0.035em`) for modern editorial impact.
* **Monospace Elements**: `JetBrains Mono` or `Fira Code` for badges, timestamps, hex commit hashes, and metrics.
* **Line Length**: Max `65ch` for prose readability (`max-w-[65ch]`). Serif fonts are strictly BANNED in dashboards.

### B. Viewport & Spatial Grid Rules
* **Anti-Center Bias**: Centered Hero sections are BANNED when `DESIGN_VARIANCE > 4`. Use asymmetric splits (50/50 split-screens, left-anchored copy with right-anchored floating interactive canvas).
* **Viewport Stability**: Never use `h-screen`. Always use `min-h-[100dvh]` to eliminate mobile address-bar jump.
* **4px / 8px Grid**: `gap-1` (4px), `gap-2` (8px), `p-3` (12px), `p-4` (16px), `p-6` (24px), `p-8` (32px).
* **CSS Grid Over Flex-Math**: Never write `w-[calc(33%-1rem)]`. Use clean CSS Grid (`grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-6`).

---

## 4. Google Material Design 3 (M3) Fluidity & Curves

### A. Timing Tokens
Never use linear or generic browser `ease`. Always use calibrated curves:

| Token | Cubic Bezier | Purpose |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Emphasized (Default)** | `cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0)` | Expandable cards, dialogs, primary transitions |
| **Emphasized Decelerate** | `cubic-bezier(0.05, 0.7, 0.1, 1.0)` | Incoming viewport elements, modals, drawers |
| **Emphasized Accelerate** | `cubic-bezier(0.3, 0.0, 0.8, 0.15)` | Exiting elements, dismissed toasts |
| **Spring Snappy** | `cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)` | Micro-interactions, hover lifts, button presses |

### B. Radial Ink Ripple Engine
Interactive surfaces emit radial ink ripples originating from exact cursor coordinate `(clientX, clientY)`:
```css
.ripple-host {
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  -webkit-mask-image: -webkit-radial-gradient(white, black);
}
.ripple-effect {
  position: absolute;
  border-radius: 50%;
  transform: scale(0);
  animation: ripple-anim 0.55s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1) forwards;
  background-color: currentColor;
  opacity: 0.14;
  pointer-events: none;
}
@keyframes ripple-anim {
  to { transform: scale(2.5); opacity: 0; }
}
```

### C. 3D Spatial Transforms
* Parent containers set `perspective: 1000px`.
* Cards support subtle elevation physics:
  ```css
  transform: perspective(1000px) rotateX(0deg) rotateY(0deg) translateZ(0);
  transition: transform 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), box-shadow 0.25s ease;
  ```
  On hover: `transform: translateY(-4px) scale(1.008);`.

---

## 5. State Handling & Copywriting Restraint

* **5 Mandatory States**: Every interactive component must specify Default, Hover, Active (`scale-[0.98]`), Dimension-matched Skeleton Loader (never raw spinners), and contextual Empty/Error states.
* **ANTI-EMOJI POLICY**: Never use emojis in code, markup, headings, or UI labels. Use clean SVG icons (Phosphor, Radix, Lucide) with uniform `strokeWidth={1.5}`.
* **Plain-Language CTAs**: Buttons declare actions directly: "Save changes" instead of "Submit"; "Publish release" instead of "Confirm".
* **Reduced Motion**: All animations must be gracefully disabled inside `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)`.
